items.name: TYLER GT TRUSS
items.notes: Industry-standard 12" aluminum box truss. Widely used in touring, corporate, and concert production. Conforms to BS EN 1090 and ANSI E1.2.

items.name: 12" BOX
items.notes: Generic 12" box truss available from multiple manufacturers. Metric equivalents common (0.5m, 1m, 2m, 3m). Verify compatibility between manufacturers before mixing.

items.name: 20.5" BOX
items.notes: Heavy-duty touring truss for long spans and high-load applications. Common in large-scale arena and stadium production.

items.name: 16" BOX
items.notes: Mid-size aluminum box truss. Good balance of capacity and weight for medium-span applications. Popular for corporate touring and mid-size event production.

items.name: CHRISTIE F-TYPE
items.notes: Christie Lites' proprietary rental truss system with F-type connector pins. Common on Christie rental packages. Not interchangeable with other manufacturer's connectors — verify availability with Christie.
